column1: # Ansible counters (playbooks, and the tasks, handlers, defaults and vars of a role), for a rule
# with the prompt file-body-ops: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line
# blanks YAML comments and the body of a block scalar (the lines below a | or >, as deep as its
# first line; the key stays, so "ansible.builtin.shell: |" counts), so a "- name:" in a shell script
# or a template does not count. "plays" counts a hosts: key, "named tasks, handlers and plays" every
# list item that starts with name:, "FQCN module calls" a fully qualified module
# (ansible.builtin.copy:, community.general.ufw:); "loops" loop: and every with_* key.
# OpsFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
